title: Jetson Orin Nano Super object detection: FPS and mAP
dek: TensorRT FP16 on the Orin Nano Super. D-FINE-S runs 30.2 FPS at 53.4 mAP, D-FINE-L 18.6 FPS at 60.0 mAP. 75 models, input sizes listed.
author: Vision Analysis

blocks.text: For 30 FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano Super, D-FINE-S is the most accurate model: 53.4 mAP at 30.2 FPS, Apache-2.0. For 60 FPS, YOLO26-N gives 40.1 mAP (AGPL-3.0). The best Apache-2.0 option at that rate is DEIMv2-Femto, 34.5 mAP at 65.7 FPS. D-FINE-X is the most accurate model overall at 61.4 mAP, but it runs at 14.2 FPS. All numbers are TensorRT FP16, batch 1, mAP@50-95 in percent.
Fastest models on the Orin Nano Super

blocks.caption: Fastest detectors on Jetson Orin Nano Super, TensorRT FP16, batch 1. Check the input column: some top rows run on smaller images.

blocks.text: DEIMv2-Atto tops this table at 89.1 FPS, but it runs at 320 px. DEIMv2-Femto, YOLOX-Tiny and YOLOX-Nano run at 416 px. Most other models run at 640 px. If you came for YOLO11: YOLO11-N runs 52.6 FPS at 38.7 mAP and YOLO11-S 41.3 FPS at 45.7 mAP, both AGPL-3.0. D-FINE-N matches YOLO11-S at 45.8 mAP and 42.1 FPS under Apache-2.0.

blocks.title: Which model for your frame rate

items.v: YOLO26-N: 40.1 mAP, AGPL-3.0. Apache-2.0: DEIMv2-Femto, 34.5 mAP

blocks.caption: Most accurate detectors on Jetson Orin Nano Super, TensorRT FP16, batch 1.

blocks.text: The top of this table splits by speed. D-FINE-X reaches 61.4 mAP at 14.2 FPS. ECDet-X and DEIMv2-X land within a point of it but run at 5.7 and 5.4 FPS. D-FINE-L, at 60.0 mAP and 18.6 FPS, gives up just over a point for about a third more frame rate.
